name: Miguel Lallo
bio: Miguel Lallo is a actor, comedian and voice actor. Born in Barra Bonita, in the interior of São Paulo, he has lived in the capital of São Paulo for nine years. He has been studying theater since he was 8 years old, and has been involved in the art ever since. He has participated in plays and festivals, where he had the opportunity to be the protagonist of the play “Barra na TV”, where he played a female comedy character. He performed in the musical “Saltimbancos”, playing the character “O jumento”. And other musicals and several plays. He has recorded some TV commercials and video clips. He gave the original voice to a cartoon called Mytikah, the character Leco. He took a dubbing course with Agatha and Flora Paulita. In the cinema, he participated in the film “Dois mais Dois”. In addition to the courses in Theater, Musical Theater, comedy and standup! He was an actor and scriptwriter for the program A Pracinha on +SBT as D. Miguelina

credits.title: Se Não Eu, Quem Vai Fazer Você Feliz?
Here the Whole Time
credits.overview: An insecure teenager's vacation plans are ruined by an unexpected visitor: his neighbor and school crush who will spend two weeks sleeping at his house. The days that promised peace, tranquility and epic series marathons end up bringing a whirlwind of feelings and unresolved issues.

However, everything turns upside down when they find out their best friends, Ricardo and Bettina, have an open marriage.
